steps.heading: Word classes
steps.html:
Noun = a naming word (dog, London). Verb = a doing/being word (run, is). Adjective = describes a noun (tall). Adverb = describes a verb (quickly).

"The happy (adj) dog (noun) barked (verb) loudly (adverb)."

steps.heading: Making words agree
steps.html:
The verb must match the subject. One thing → is/was; more than one → are/were.

The children are playing. (not "is")

steps.stem: Which word is the VERB in: 'She quickly opened the door.'?
steps.explain: A verb is a doing word — "opened".

steps.stem: Choose the correct word: 'The children ___ playing.'
Which is the past tense of 'run'?
steps.explain: "Run" is irregular; its past tense is "ran".
